mcqs.question:
With reference to the AP Cyber Guard system, consider the following statements:
1. Complaints received through the 1930 helpline are to be responded to within the first 30 minutes, with temporary lien marking on accounts.
2. The system includes a 24×7 Cyber War Room, AI monitoring, a three-tier district mechanism and training for 500 police personnel.
3. The 1930 helpline operates under the National Biodiversity Authority, established in 2018.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options: 1 and 2 only
2 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct features of the AP Cyber Guard system. Statement 3 is incorrect because the 1930 helpline operates under I4C, which was established in 2018; it is not under the National Biodiversity Authority.

mcqs.question: Euphorbia ananthapuramensis, one of the newly reported plant species from Andhra Pradesh’s Eastern Ghats, was recorded in which setting?
options: Nigidi forest in Sri Sathya Sai district, among granite rocks at 450–550 metres
Madanapalle in Annamayya district, along cultivated agricultural fields at 200–300 metres
Vizianagaram district, in mangrove vegetation at 50–150 metres
Prakasam district, in coastal sand dunes at 600–700 metres
mcqs.explanation: Euphorbia ananthapuramensis was recorded in Nigidi forest of Sri Sathya Sai district, among granite rocks at 450–550 metres. The other options change the location, habitat or elevation.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the annual rotation of representation in the National Biodiversity Authority, match List-I with List-II.

List-I
 a. State 1
 b. State 2
 c. State 3

List-II
 i. Odisha
 ii. Madhya Pradesh
 iii. Tripura

Choose the correct code:
options: a-ii, b-iii, c-i
a-i, b-ii, c-iii
a-iii, b-i, c-ii
a-ii, b-i, c-iii
mcqs.explanation: The three States also represented in the annual rotation are Madhya Pradesh, Tripura and Odisha. Therefore, the correct pairs are a-ii, b-iii and c-i; the other codes rearrange these States.

mcqs.question: The Godavari Pushkaram, for which Andhra Pradesh formed an Environmental Protection Task Force, is held when which of the following occurs?
options: Every 12 years, when Jupiter enters Leo (Simha Rasi)
Every 10 years, when Jupiter enters Aries (Mesha Rasi)
Every 12 years, when Jupiter enters Sagittarius (Dhanu Rasi)
Every 6 years, when Jupiter enters Leo (Simha Rasi)
mcqs.explanation: Godavari Pushkaram occurs every 12 years when Jupiter enters Leo, known as Simha Rasi. The other options alter either the interval or the zodiac sign.

mcqs.question: The Electric Field Monitor-based Lightning Early Warning Project is aligned with which framework that stresses early warning for disasters?
options: Sendai Framework, 2015–2030
Sendai Framework, 2005–2020
Paris Agreement, 2015–2030
Hyogo Framework, 2015–2030
mcqs.explanation: The project reflects the Sendai Framework for 2015–2030, which stresses early warning. The remaining options either give the wrong framework or the wrong period.

mcqs.keyword: Food Planet Prize presentation and award amount
mcqs.question: In connection with the Food Planet Prize 2026, where and when were the finalist presentations scheduled, and what was the approximate prize for the winner?
options: Båstad, Sweden, in June 2026; approximately ₹14 crore
Stockholm, Sweden, in May 2026; approximately ₹1.40 crore
Båstad, Sweden, in June 2026; approximately ₹1.40 crore
Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2026; approximately ₹14 crore
mcqs.explanation: The finalist presentations were scheduled at Båstad, Sweden, in June 2026, and the winner’s prize was approximately ₹14 crore. Approximately ₹1.40 crore was the amount for finalists, not the winner, while the other options change the venue or date.

mcqs.keyword: Observatory function and agricultural institution focus
mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: C-ART at Andhra University uses remote sensing and an Eddy Covariance Tower to provide early warnings for cyclones, and Andhra University was established in 1926.
Statement B: The proposed Indian School of Agriculture at Madanapalle will focus only on agricultural research and will not include technology, skills or agri-startups.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true: C-ART uses remote sensing and an Eddy Covariance Tower for cyclone early warnings, and Andhra University was established in 1926. Statement B is false because the Indian School of Agriculture will also focus on technology, skills and agri-startups.
